question: The government launched the Stand - Up India scheme to promote entrepreneurship among ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women and SC/ST communities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Stand-Up India scheme was launched by the Indian government to promote entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities.**
 
• The main objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to women and SC/ST entrepreneurs to start their own businesses and become job creators rather than job seekers.
 
• The scheme provides loans ranging from Rs.10 lakh to Rs.1 crore to eligible beneficiaries for setting up new enterprises or expanding existing ones.
 
• The scheme also provides handholding support to beneficiaries in the form of skill training, mentorship, and market linkages to ensure the success of their businesses.
 
• The scheme has been successful in promoting entrepreneurship and creating employment opportunities for women and SC/ST communities across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Stand-Up India scheme is not specifically targeted towards disabled individuals. However, they can also benefit from the scheme if they belong to the eligible categories of women or SC/ST communities.
 
• The Stand-Up India scheme is not specifically targeted towards the transgender community. However, they can also benefit from the scheme if they belong to the eligible categories of women or SC/ST communities.
 
• The Stand-Up India scheme is not specifically targeted towards elderly individuals. However, they can also benefit from the scheme if they belong to the eligible categories of women or SC/ST communities.
